metadata.datum_statement: Original bathymetry metadata describes adjustment to MLLW using predicted local tides. The separate NCEI 2000 raw-survey collection metadata uses generic MSL / EPSG:5715. These differing scopes do not establish a verified datum for the composite grid; normalized depth datum remains unknown.
metadata.horizontal_accuracy: Producer approximate ±2m, varies with depth; confidence level unspecified.
metadata.vertical_accuracy: Producer approximate ±20cm, varies with depth; confidence level unspecified; no uncertainty band.
metadata.processing: CARIS cleaned soundings exported shoal-biased at1m, gridded in Fledermaus AverageGridder to2m, exported original ArcInfo grid; retained producer mask, no separate interpolation mask.
metadata.lineage: Composite original, not an independent source from derived backscatter/hillshade/slope or USGS compilations sharing the same survey. Exact overlap lineage is unresolved, no independence bonus.

review.attribution: Data used in this study were acquired, processed, archived, and distributed by the Seafloor Mapping Lab of California State University Monterey Bay.

rights.limitation: General producer public-use policy permits credited noncommercial display; for-profit permission not obtained. NOAA hosting grants no new rights.

acquisition_benefit.limitations: Source native nominal0–91.44m pixels intersect retained masks. Historical checked snapshot, not a new qualified reach result or release. Fragmented boundaries and approximate2m horizontal uncertainty limit interpretation of the small delta.

disposition: Original native source qualified for credited noncommercial processing; physical habitat and whole-polygon publication screening remain separate.
